text: Estonian **licence plates** are long and white, with the standard blue European strip on the left.
text_zh: 愛沙尼亞的**車牌**是長條白色，左側帶有標準的藍色歐洲標誌條。

text: Estonian bollards have a **round, baton-like shape**.
They have a rectangular reflector on the front and two circular reflectors on the back. The reflectors can be white or orange.
NOTE: Latvian and Lithuanian bollards look different.
!![This infographic](/images/estonia/nordics_bollards.png) shows the main similarities and differences between the bollards of the Baltic and Nordic countries.
text_zh: 愛沙尼亞的路樁具有**圓形、指揮棒狀的形狀**。
它們正面有一個長方形反光片，背面有兩個圓形反光片。反光片可以是白色或橘色。
注意：拉脫維亞和立陶宛的路樁看起來不同。
!![這張資訊圖表](/images/estonia/nordics_bollards.png)展示了波羅的海與北歐國家路樁的主要相似處與相異處。

text: Estonia uses a variety of different poles and poletops. Of the three Baltic countries, it has the least consistent utility poles.
**Round wooden** poles are the most common, sometimes with diagonal supports.
text_zh: 愛沙尼亞使用各種不同的電線桿與桿頂。在三個波羅的海國家中，它的電線桿一致性最低。
**圓木桿**最為常見，有時帶有斜向支撐。

text: You can additionally find a fair amount of **square concrete** poles, often also with diagonal supports. These are similar to those found in Lithuania.
text_zh: 你另外可以找到相當數量的**方形混凝土**桿，通常也帶有斜向支撐。這些類似於立陶宛常見的電線桿。

text: **Trident pole tops** are somewhat common: This pole top features one insulator on top, and two to the side.
text_zh: **三叉桿頂**相當常見：這種桿頂特色在於上方有一個絕緣體，兩側各有一個。

text: Most wooden poles have a small **metal cap on top**, similar to those found in the Nordic countries.
NOTE: Alongside the Nordic countries of Sweden, Finland and Norway, these caps can also sometimes be found in Latvia.
text_zh: 多數木桿**頂端都有一個金屬小帽**，類似於北歐國家常見的款式。
注意：除了瑞典、芬蘭和挪威等北歐國家外，這些金屬帽有時也會出現在拉脫維亞。

text: Outer road lines sometimes consist of **short dashes**.
NOTE: Lithuania also sometimes has short dashes.
!!In addition, Sweden primarily uses short dashes as outer road lines.
text_zh: 道路外側標線有時由**短虛線**組成。
注意：立陶宛有時也會使用短虛線。
!!此外，瑞典主要也將短虛線作為道路外側標線。

text: Estonia uses **red chevrons with white arrows.**
NOTE: Russia and Ukraine use the same chevrons.
!!However, Latvian and Lithuanian chevrons have the opposite colour scheme: they are white with red arrows.
text_zh: 愛沙尼亞使用**帶有白色箭頭的紅色轉彎標誌**。
注意：俄羅斯和烏克蘭使用相同的轉彎標誌。
!!然而，拉脫維亞和立陶宛的轉彎標誌配色正好相反：它們是白色底配紅色箭頭。

text: All Baltic countries use the same blue kilometre marker. However, they can be distinguished from each other by their angle relative to the road.
In Estonia, the marker will be **perpendicular** to the road. It has numbers on both sides of the marker.
For a quick overview of all three Baltic countries, [see this infographic.](/images/estonia/baltics_kmmarkerinfographic.png)
text_zh: 所有波羅的海國家都使用相同的藍色公里標示牌。不過，可以透過它們相對於道路的角度來彼此區分。
在愛沙尼亞，標示牌會與道路**垂直**。標示牌的兩側都有數字。
若要快速瀏覽所有三個波羅的海國家，請[參見此資訊圖表。](/images/estonia/baltics_kmmarkerinfographic.png)

text: Each Baltic country has a slightly different border for its warning and speed signs.
Estonian signs have a **thin** red border, with **no white outline** around it (the red border extends all the way to the edge of the sign).
text_zh: 每個波羅的海國家的警告標誌與速限標誌邊框略有不同。
愛沙尼亞的標誌具有**細的**紅邊，且**沒有白色外框**（紅色邊框一直延伸到標誌邊緣）。

text: Estonia has normal A-type guardrails with **no reflectors**.
NOTE: The other two Baltic countries can have reflectors on their guardrails. For a good overview of European guardrails, see [this infographic](/images/estonia/europeguardrail.png).
text_zh: 愛沙尼亞有著**沒有反光片**的一般 A 型護欄。
注意：另外兩個波羅的海國家的護欄上可能有反光片。若要完整了解歐洲護欄，請參見[此資訊圖表](/images/estonia/europeguardrail.png)。

text: Estonian pedestrian signs have **3 stripes**. The shape of the pedestrian has a relatively high level of detail, detailing **shoes** and an **attached head**.
NOTE: Lithuanian signs also have 3 stripes, but the pedestrian looks less detailed.
!!Latvian pedestrian signs have 5 stripes.
text_zh: 愛沙尼亞的行人標誌有 **3 條紋**。行人的形狀具有相對高等級的細節，描繪出**鞋子**與**連體的頭部**。
注意：立陶宛的標誌也有 3 條紋，但行人看起來細節較少。
!!拉脫維亞的行人標誌有 5 條紋。

text: Estonian bus stop signs have this design.
The bus has **four windows**. This is mostly useful to distinguish it from the Latvian bus stop sign, which has five windows.
Note, however, that Lithuania has the same bus stop signs as Estonia.
text_zh: 愛沙尼亞的公車站牌採用這種設計。
公車有**四扇窗戶**。這主要有助於將其與擁有五扇窗戶的拉脫維亞公車站牌區分開來。
不過請注意，立陶宛使用與愛沙尼亞相同的公車站牌。

text: These **blue and white** signpost wrappings are very common in Estonia.
NOTE: They are also common in Finland and Sweden.
text_zh: 這些**藍白相間**的指標包覆在愛沙尼亞非常常見。
注意：它們在芬蘭和瑞典也很常見。

text: **Estonian** belongs to the Finnic languages, a branch of the Uralic language family. It is closely related to Finnish.
Within the Baltic languages, the following letters are unique to Estonian:
- Vowels with umlauts (two dots): Ä Ö Ü.
- Õ with a tilde.
NOTE: Latvian and Lithuanian are both Indo-European languages that are not related to Estonian, and therefore look very different.
text_zh: **愛沙尼亞語**屬於芬蘭語支，是烏拉爾語系的一個分支。它與芬蘭語密切相關。
在波羅的海諸語言中，下列字母是愛沙尼亞語特有的：
- 帶分音符（兩點）的母音：Ä Ö Ü。
- 帶波浪符的 Õ。
注意：拉脫維亞語和立陶宛語都是印歐語系語言，與愛沙尼亞語無關，因此看起來非常不同。

text: The Estonian words for street and road are **tänav** and **tee**, respectively. These words are unique to Estonian. Tänav is often abbreviated as ‘tn’.
Many streets, especially in urban areas, have a simple name that completely lacks the tänav and or tee suffix.
NOTE: The Finnish suffix -tie, meaning street, can look similar.
text_zh: 愛沙尼亞語中街道和道路的詞分別是 **tänav** 和 **tee**。這些詞是愛沙尼亞語特有的。Tänav 通常縮寫為 ‘tn’。
許多街道，特別是在市區，都有一個完全沒有 tänav 或 tee 字尾的簡單名稱。
注意：芬蘭語表示街道的字尾 -tie 看起來可能很相似。

text: It is fairly common to find **oval-shaped** blue house numbers in Estonia.

NOTE: This is not common in the other Baltic countries, but can also be found in [Russia](https://www.google.com/maps/@59.0913517,28.1667574,3a,15y,304.49h,91.94t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sTX_XXjOnF4tmR0_rySvAQQ!2e0!5s20130601T000000!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu).
text_zh: 在愛沙尼亞經常可以找到**橢圓形**的藍色門牌號碼。
注意：這在其他波羅的海國家並不常見，但也能在[俄羅斯](https://www.google.com/maps/@59.0913517,28.1667574,3a,15y,304.49h,91.94t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sTX_XXjOnF4tmR0_rySvAQQ!2e0!5s20130601T000000!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)找到。

text: Estonian architecture generally consists of a combination of wood and white brick, typically with somewhat steep corrugated metal roofs. Painted stone walls are also somewhat common. While wooden buildings can be found in all three Baltic countries, they are more common in Estonia.
text_zh: 愛沙尼亞的建築通常由木材與白磚結合而成，一般搭配稍微陡峭的波浪狀金屬屋頂。漆過的石牆也相當常見。雖然木造建築在所有三個波羅的海國家都能找到，但在愛沙尼亞更為普遍。

text: Directional signs in Estonia are blue with white text and a white outline.

NOTE: In [Finland](https://maps.app.goo.gl/SsE9X8eTamwvhp1T6), the arrow is built into the white border instead of being an icon inside the border. The arrow on [Latvian](https://goo.gl/maps/g3aqkLH6yjQwrCSF7) signs is more stylized than in Estonia and [Lithuania](https://goo.gl/maps/17A5xxGivFmbs4ae8), where the back part of the arrowhead is vertical.
text_zh: 愛沙尼亞的指標是藍底白字，帶有白色外框。
注意：在[芬蘭](https://maps.app.goo.gl/SsE9X8eTamwvhp1T6)，箭頭是內建在白色邊框中，而不是邊框內的圖示。[拉脫維亞](https://goo.gl/maps/g3aqkLH6yjQwrCSF7)標誌上的箭頭比愛沙尼亞和[立陶宛](https://goo.gl/maps/17A5xxGivFmbs4ae8)更具設計感，後者的箭頭尾部是垂直的。

text: Generation 3 coverage in Estonia often has a slight green tint to part of the panorama, which is referred to as “**green blur**” by the community.

For many players, this green blur can be hard to identify at first. The location shown in this tip’s image is a fairly extreme example. To familiarise you with how it might look in-game, here are some more examples where it is fairly visible: [1](https://goo.gl/maps/wRwNJGnT6JyKTjyx9), [2](https://goo.gl/maps/ivTZffp9bnQfVCaU6), [3](https://goo.gl/maps/qpR7tU68UehPT8Rr6), [4](https://goo.gl/maps/r8tN2ahKmzEhUsG18).
NOTE: This discoloration usually does not occur in Latvia and Lithuania.
!!It can however also be found in Sweden, often on the island of Gotland.
text_zh: 愛沙尼亞的第三代街景覆蓋在全景的一部分經常帶有微綠色調，被社群稱為「**綠色模糊**」。

對許多玩家來說，這種綠色模糊一開始很難識別。這個提示的圖片中所顯示的地點是一個相當極端的例子。為了讓你熟悉它在遊戲中可能看起來的樣子，這裡有更多它相當明顯的範例：[1](https://goo.gl/maps/wRwNJGnT6JyKTjyx9)、[2](https://goo.gl/maps/ivTZffp9bnQfVCaU6)、[3](https://goo.gl/maps/qpR7tU68UehPT8Rr6)、[4](https://goo.gl/maps/r8tN2ahKmzEhUsG18)。
注意：這種變色通常不會發生在拉脫維亞和立陶宛。
!!不過它也可以在瑞典找到，通常是在哥特蘭島（Gotland）上。

text: The Generation 3 coverage in Estonia is more extensive than the other two Baltic countries, meaning that a lot of **very rural roads** are covered. As a result, if you are considering guessing in one of the Baltic countries, and your location is Generation 3 on a very thin and rural road, you are slightly more likely to be in Estonia.
Of course, use caution. This meta has many variables, and is not always reliable. Only use it as a last resort in no-info Baltic roulette rounds, when you have no better clues available.
text_zh: 愛沙尼亞的第三代街景覆蓋比其他兩個波羅的海國家更廣泛，這意味著許多**非常鄉村的道路**都有街景覆蓋。因此，如果你正在考慮在其中一個波羅的海國家盲猜，而你的位置是第三代街景且在一條非常狹窄的鄉村道路上，你有稍微高的機率身處愛沙尼亞。
當然，請小心行事。這個特徵線索有許多變數，並非總是可靠。只有在毫無頭緒的波羅的海輪盤回合中，當你沒有更好的線索可用時，才將其作為最後手段。

text: Estonia is a fairly flat country throughout, with only 10% of the country being higher than 100 metres, and the highest point being 318 metres tall.

Still, the **hilly parts** can sometimes be recognizable. The hilliest areas are in the southeast, and the southern half of Lääne-Viru County. Note that the colours of this map are highly exaggerated to show the location of the hills more clearly.
text_zh: 愛沙尼亞整體來說是一個相當平坦的國家，僅有 10% 的國土海拔高於 100 公尺，最高點為 318 公尺。
儘管如此，**丘陵地帶**有時還是能夠被認出來。最起伏的地區位於東南部以及西維魯縣（Lääne-Viru County）的南部。請注意，這張地圖的顏色被大幅誇大，以便更清楚地顯示丘陵的位置。

text: Estonia has a large Russian minority. In most of Ida-Viru County, they form a majority. As a result, you will sometimes see bilingual signs with **Russian Cyrillic** and Estonian in the region in and around Narva.
Note that the majority of signs will still be in Estonian. You may occasionally see Cyrillic in other places.
text_zh: 愛沙尼亞有龐大的俄羅斯少數族群。在伊達-維魯縣（Ida-Viru County）的大部分地區，他們佔了多數。因此，納爾瓦（Narva）及其周邊地區有時會看到帶有**俄羅斯西里爾字母**與愛沙尼亞語的雙語標誌。
請注意，多數標誌仍會是愛沙尼亞語。你偶爾可能會在其他地方看到西里爾字母。

text: The old town of Tallinn looks very different from any other urban area in Estonia. It is an almost perfectly preserved historic area, with lots of **medieval and renaissance-era buildings**. In places, it can look a lot like cities in central Europe.
text_zh: 塔林（Tallinn）的舊城區看起來與愛沙尼亞任何其他市區截然不同。這是一個幾乎完美保存的歷史區域，有著大量**中世紀和文藝復興時期的建築**。在某些地方，它看起來非常像中歐的城市。

text: Kihnu is a small island off the coast that has recognizable coverage:
- All coverage is Generation 4, taken during **late autumn** (recognizable by the fallen brown leaves on the ground).
- Noticeably, it has a very **moody, dark cloud cover**, taken close to sunset.
If you see a combination of these two things, Kihnu is a good place to guess.
NOTE: Near Tartu you can also get a fair amount of autumn coverage, sometimes with a fair amount of cloud cover.
text_zh: 基赫努島（Kihnu）是離岸的一座小島，擁有可辨識的街景覆蓋：
- 所有街景覆蓋均為第四代，拍攝於**深秋**（可透過地上落下的褐色落葉辨認）。
- 特別值得注意的是，它有非常**陰鬱的厚重雲層**，拍攝時間接近日落。
如果你看到這兩種特徵的組合，基赫努島（Kihnu）會是一個很好的猜測地點。
注意：在塔爾圖（Tartu）附近，你也會遇到相當多的秋季街景覆蓋，有時還伴隨著相當厚的雲層。
